requiredDatabaseTotals.countBasis: Only node:test summary blocks inside the required DB runner's selected pnpm suite groups, between its selection and timings markers; each group has an exact matching '<script>: OK' result. Summaries outside those groups, bootstrap/setup and separate early identity/privacy steps are excluded. The 68 selected script identities are unique across all four shards.
requiredDatabaseTotals.interpretation: Counts are actual non-skipped test executions in required database-gate scripts, which may also contain pure subtests; not a count of SQL statements, live models, production subscription runs or unique test files.
